entities.summary: Friedrich Gorenstein was a Soviet and German Russian-language author and screenwriter of Ukrainian Jewish decent. His works primarily deal with Stalinism, antisemitism, and the philosophical-religious view of a peaceful coexistence between Jews and Christians.
